description: Kit for Plotwell, an AI ad agent that drafts one campaign like a blueprint and runs it on 33 ad platforms: 16 dashboard icons, a 3D drafting-compass hero and agent-bot mascot, six feature cards, a plan-sheet launch banner and a case-study banner, an announcement film, a live-demo countdown, a promo and a customer-quote video, and animated plotter-desk and platform-network scenes.
